envVarDesc.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: The API URL of your Supabase project. Every request, including database and auth, uses it as the base URL.
envVarDesc.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: The Supabase anonymous (public) key. It is safe to expose in the browser and is used to read public data.
envVarDesc.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: The Supabase service role key. It is server-only and bypasses access rules, so never expose it.
envVarDesc.NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB3FORMS_KEY: The Web3Forms access key. Used to send the contact form.
envVarDesc.NEXT_PUBLIC_FORMSPREE_ID: The Formspree form ID. Used to send the contact form.
envVarDesc.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_SERVICE_ID: The EmailJS service ID. Used when the contact form is sent through EmailJS.
envVarDesc.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_TEMPLATE_ID: The EmailJS template ID. Sets the format of the email that is sent.
envVarDesc.NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAILJS_PUBLIC_KEY: The EmailJS public key. Used when the browser calls EmailJS.
envVarDesc.NEXT_PUBLIC_RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY: The Google reCAPTCHA site key. It is safe to expose in the browser and is used to block spam.
envVarDesc.NANOBANANA_API_KEY: The NanoBanana (Gemini image generation) API key. Used to generate AI cover images.
envVarDesc.HUGGINGFACE_API_KEY: The Hugging Face inference token. Used to call image generation models such as FLUX.
envVarDesc.GEMINI_API_KEY: The Google Gemini API key. Used for summaries, translation, image generation, and more.
envVarDesc.OPENAI_API_KEY: The OpenAI API key. Used to call OpenAI models for summaries, translation, and more.
envVarDesc.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: The Anthropic Claude API key. Used to call Claude models for summaries, translation, and more.
envVarDesc.GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_API_KEY: The Google Cloud Translation API key. Used to translate post content.
envVarDesc.DEEPL_API_KEY: The DeepL API key (Free or Pro). Used to translate post content.
envVarDesc.UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY: The Unsplash access key. Used to search for and insert images.
envVarDesc.PEXELS_API_KEY: The Pexels API key. Used to search for images and videos.
envVarDesc.RESEND_API_KEY: The Resend API key. Used to send transactional email such as new comment notifications.
envVarDesc.GITHUB_TOKEN: The GitHub personal access token used to load giscus repository details. Read access to public repositories is enough, and both classic (ghp_) and fine-grained (github_pat_) tokens work.
envVarDesc.CRON_SECRET: The password for triggering scheduled jobs, such as scheduled publishing and trash cleanup, from outside. The site normally runs these jobs inside Supabase, so it works even when this is empty. Only when you need to call them through an external service such as cron-job.org, put a long random string in the .env file or in the Vercel environment variables. It cannot be edited in the admin; you can only check whether the server has a value.
